name: Stripe payment thank-you
description: When Stripe reports a successful payment, draft a personalised thank-you in your voice and post it to your team's Slack #wins channel so the whole team sees the customer love.

config.prompt:
A Stripe payment just succeeded. The trigger payload is at {{trigger}}. Draft a 2-3 sentence Slack message in the user's voice celebrating the payment. Include:
- The customer name (or email if name is missing)
- The amount paid (formatted with currency)
- One line of warmth that matches the user's tone in memory.

Return ONLY the message text — no markdown headers, no preamble.

rationale_at_seed: Composio's STRIPE_PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED trigger fires once per successful charge — no polling on the user's side.
Two-node chain: agent drafts the message, channel_message posts it. Keeps the LLM focused on tone, leaves the send to a deterministic node.
iteration_cap=4 is plenty: there are no tool calls inside the draft step — pure prose.
Slack target channel_id is left empty so the catalog UI prompts the user to pick which channel (#wins, #sales, etc.) at seed time.
Timeout 120s is generous — the bottleneck is the LLM draft, not the channel send.
